_timezone_note: Fixture-local timezone. Seed times are authored to read as LOCAL wall clock and stored with a Z suffix -- 'Thursday sync' 14:00 is 2pm, the dentist 16:30 is 4:30pm, the 1:1 10:00 is 10am. Read as EDT instead they become 10:00, 12:30 and 06:00, and a 6am 1:1 is not what anyone authored. So the fixture's local zone IS UTC. The DRIVER exports TZ from this field when spawning the agent: without it the agent takes the timezone from the host, which made the same corpus score differently by machine and across DST. Observed 2026-09-21: an arm reasoned 'the Thursday sync at 14:00Z is 10:00 EDT -- morning' and was scored WRONG by a clause evaluating in UTC. Its reasoning was correct; the input was uncontrolled.
